commit.message:
fix(prediction): batch by fixed size by default (#1695)

- `_default_batch` returns `context.batch_size` when the model has a fixed batch size, streamed or not; it returned 1, so `predict(folder)` on a predictor from `inference(batch_size=N)` or a fixed-batch export with N above one failed on its first batch with `Batch size mismatch` unless the caller passed `batch=N`
- `TestDefaultBatch` covers a directory run in batches of a fixed batch size of two, eager and streamed, plus the eight-image default on a model without a fixed batch size
- `predict` docstrings in `_prediction/core.py` and `inference.py`, `videos-and-streams.md` and a CHANGELOG Fixed entry describe the default; a final batch with fewer than N images is still refused, not padded
- Correct fixed-batch guidance in the user guide, changelog and prediction docstrings.
- Distinguish finite batching from simultaneous live batches, including source-count requirements and rejection of short final finite batches.

---------

@@ -10,6 +10,10 @@ The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/),
 
 - Segmentation prediction with `RFDETR.predict()` and `RFDETRInference.predict()` no longer copies every full-resolution mask on the device a second time when all detections pass the threshold. Post-processing already drops masks below the score threshold, so decoding now selects mask rows only when it removes some, as with per-class thresholds or a custom post-processor. Returned masks stay independent of the post-processor's tensors. On a Tesla T4, decoding 100 masks at 1920×1080 peaked at 198 MiB less CUDA memory and took 15.8 ms instead of 17.6 ms; this covers mask decoding and the copy to the CPU, not the model forward pass or mask resizing. Predictions are unchanged. ([#1688](https://github.com/roboflow/rf-detr/pull/1688))
 
+### Fixed
+
+- `RFDETRInference.predict()` without `batch` now predicts a directory, glob or recorded video in batches of the fixed batch size of a predictor from `RFDETR.inference(batch_size=N)` or of a fixed-batch export, with either `stream=True` or `stream=False`. It used one image per batch, so any `N` above one failed on the first batch with `Batch size mismatch` unless the caller passed `batch=N`. A final batch with fewer than `N` images is still refused, not padded. Live captures and `.streams` manifests keep one frame per source in each simultaneous batch, regardless of `batch`; their source count must match the runtime's fixed batch size.
+
 ## [1.12.0] — 2026-11-05
 
 ### Added

@@ -162,7 +162,11 @@ An empty collection of sources is quiet; an empty location is loud. A text or CS
 
 ## Batching and frame stride
 
-Use `batch` to set the number of finite images or frames per forward pass. The default, `batch=None`, runs a BCHW tensor or a list of images as one forward pass, predicts a directory or glob in batches of eight when results are collected (`stream=False`) and the model accepts any batch size, and predicts other expanded or streamed sources one image or frame at a time. Pass an integer to split a BCHW tensor or a list of images into smaller batches and bound the memory of each pass. RF-DETR predicts the final partial batch when the source length is not divisible by `batch`. An inference-compiled model may require the batch size used during compilation.
+Use `batch` to set the number of finite images or recorded video frames per forward pass. The default, `batch=None`, runs a BCHW tensor or a list of images as one forward pass. On a model without a fixed batch size, an eager directory or glob uses batches of eight (or a smaller export `max_batch_size`), and other finite expanded or streamed inputs use one image or frame at a time. Pass an integer to split a BCHW tensor or a list of images into smaller batches and bound the memory of each pass.
+
+A predictor from `model.inference(batch_size=N)` or an export with a fixed batch size accepts only batches of `N`. For finite expanded sources, such as directories, globs and recorded videos, `batch=None` uses `N` with either `stream=True` or `stream=False`. RF-DETR predicts a final partial batch when the source length is not divisible by `batch`, except when the runtime requires a fixed batch size: it rejects a final batch with fewer than `N` images and does not pad it.
+
+Live captures and `.streams` manifests preserve simultaneous batches with one frame per source, regardless of `batch`. They do not accumulate consecutive frames to fill a batch. A fixed-batch runtime therefore requires the number of concurrent sources to equal `N`: a single camera, RTSP stream or screen capture needs a batch-one or dynamic-batch runtime, and a `.streams` manifest needs exactly `N` sources.
 
 Set `vid_stride` to capture every Nth frame for prediction. It defaults to `1`. For live sources, the latest-frame policy can still skip frames when prediction is slower than capture.

+def four_image_dir(tmp_path: Path) -> Path:
+    """A directory of four small PNG images, enough for two batches of two."""
+    for index in range(4):
+        PIL.Image.fromarray(np.full((32, 32, 3), index * 40, dtype=np.uint8)).save(tmp_path / f"{index}.png")

+
+class TestDefaultBatch:
+    """``predict(batch=None)`` sizes the batches of an expanded source from the model's batch constraint."""
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("stream", [False, True])
+    def test_fixed_batch_model_runs_directory_in_its_batch_size(
+        self, mocker: MockerFixture, four_image_dir: Path, stream: bool
+    ) -> None:
+        """A directory runs in batches of the fixed batch size of a compiled snapshot or fixed-batch export.
+
+        A predictor from ``inference(batch_size=2)`` rejects every other batch size, so a default of one image per batch
+        made ``predict(folder)`` fail on its first batch unless the caller repeated the size as ``batch``.
+        """
+        live = _DummyRFDETR()._prediction_context()
+        run = mocker.Mock(wraps=live.run)
+        context = replace(live, batch_size=2, run=run)
+
+        results = list(core.predict(lambda: context, four_image_dir, stream=stream))
+
+        assert len(results) == 4
+        assert [call.args[0].shape[0] for call in run.call_args_list] == [2, 2]
+
+    def test_dynamic_batch_model_runs_eager_directory_in_one_batch(
+        self, mocker: MockerFixture, four_image_dir: Path
+    ) -> None:
+        """An eager directory on a model without a fixed batch size runs up to eight images per batch.
+
+        Four images fit in one batch of the eight-image default, so the forward pass runs once.
+        """
+        live = _DummyRFDETR()._prediction_context()
+        run = mocker.Mock(wraps=live.run)
+        context = replace(live, run=run)
+
+        results = core.predict(lambda: context, four_image_dir)
+
+        assert len(results) == 4
+        assert [call.args[0].shape[0] for call in run.call_args_list] == [4]
